name: Google Maps
description: A maps and local discovery service. Search places, read business details, and open route choices in Google Maps. No sign-in required.

id.description: An opaque Google Maps identifier or canonical URL for this place.

url.description: The place page in Google Maps.

details.description: Visible category, address, price, and open-status details when available.

id.description: An opaque Google Maps identifier or canonical URL for this place.

url.description: The place page in Google Maps.

actions.label: Search places
actions.description: Finds paginated places and local businesses with ratings, visible details, map links, and coordinates when available.

query.description: A place name, address, category, or local search. Include the target city, neighborhood, or coordinates for geographic searches.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

actions.label: Get place details
actions.description: Reads one place's address, category, rating, hours, contact details, map link, and coordinates when available.

query.description: The place name or address to open.

placeId.description: An optional Google Maps place identifier used to disambiguate the query.

actions.label: Open directions
actions.description: Builds a Google Maps route page for the chosen origin, destination, and travel mode. Google Maps presents the available route choices; this does not start navigation.

origin.description: Starting place, address, or latitude and longitude. When omitted, Google Maps may use the device's relevant starting location.

destination.description: Destination place, address, or latitude and longitude.

originPlaceId.description: Optional Google Maps place identifier for the origin. Provide origin when using it.

destinationPlaceId.description: Optional Google Maps place identifier for the destination.
